segments.name: accounts payable
segments.description: Sells a platform that automates bill payment, invoicing and spend management for small businesses.
segments.evidence: Segment Reporting The Company operates as one operating segment because its chief operating decision maker (CODM), who is the Chief Executive Officer, reviews its financial information on a consolidated basis with net income (loss) as the primary measure of segment profitability for purposes of making decisions regarding allocating resources and assessing performance.

revenueModel.text: Small and mid-sized businesses pay subscription and transaction fees to pay suppliers and collect payments.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Solution Our intelligent platform automates the SMB back office and enables businesses using our solutions to pay their suppliers and collect payments from their clients, acting as a system of control for their accounts payable, accounts receivable, and spend and expense management activities.
